postal_system.assignment_rule: Royal Gibraltar Post Office is the designated operator. UPU August 2026 lists GX11 1AA as the single postcode for the whole country; this is one generic identifier, not evidence of subdivided postal polygons.
postal_system.domestic_exception_rule: UPU records E/V as a domestic-mail alternative to postcode and country name. E/V is an addressing exception, not a second postcode or an area.
postal_system.geometry_rule: A territory boundary may be displayed only after explicit reuse, derivative, publication and serving rights are established, and must be labelled virtual country-wide context rather than official postal geometry.
postal_system.geoportal_rule: HM Government of Gibraltar publishes WMS/WFS services, but its disclaimer says access does not imply a licence to reproduce or distribute information without prior approval. No feature geometry is acquired or promoted.
postal_system.address_rule: Official Gibraltar Address Register records are address context at address grain. They do not create a postal boundary and are not queried, copied or committed.
postal_system.identity_rule: Keep GI separate from GB and Spain and do not alter or merge the registered territory identity or boundary.

exception_classes.rule: Preserve E/V as a domestic addressing exception; do not normalize it to a second postcode or Polygon.
PO Box and organization addresses may use GX11 1AA but receive no address-, building-, box- or route-derived surface.
GX11 1AA is a country-wide generic code. Any display surface is virtual context and never an operator-certified delivery zone.
Public viewing or WFS availability does not authorize copying, publication or redistribution; keep geometry unavailable until permission is documented.

quality_gates.pass: Every source and artifact has provider, role, edition, validity, retrieval time, byte count, SHA-256 where obtainable, terms, attribution and permitted-use record.
The denominator is exactly one current normalized code GX11 1AA, with E/V retained only as a domestic addressing exception.
Operator assignment, UPU reference, territory geometry, OAR address rows, parcels/buildings, virtual display and AGID index remain separate.
Every promoted geometry is a valid non-empty source-linked Polygon/MultiPolygon, rights-cleared and explicitly virtual; it is never called an official postal boundary.
Real GI data passes normalization, no-result, API failure, invalid geometry, fit, translucent fill, visible outline, provenance, clear and re-search checks.
No person, recipient, customer, real address, OAR entry, parcel, building, owner, credential or raw restricted row is published.
Synthetic fixtures validate behavior but never satisfy production assignment, geometry, rights, artifact or app gates.

stages.definition: Source roles, generic-code semantics, territory scope, rights and missing geometry are inventoried.
The country-specific contract and blocked-source evidence are reviewable without raw address, land or restricted data.

Current Royal Gibraltar Post Office and UPU evidence establishes GX11 1AA as Gibraltar's single generic country-wide postcode and records the domestic E/V exception. A current rights-cleared Gibraltar territory Polygon/MultiPolygon is pinned by edition, validity, terms, SHA-256 and coverage, published as an approved immutable artifact, explicitly classified virtual rather than an official postal boundary, and passes the real GI loader, API and app search-to-translucent-area path. A government map or WFS without reproduction and distribution permission, address-register rows, parcels, buildings, points, synthetic fixtures and invented delivery zones never satisfy M2.
Coverage, topology, ambiguity, privacy, freshness, correction and independent validation gates pass.
Two refreshes pass and monitored rollback operates.
